text: {"lessons":["A few months of falling prices are not enough evidence to make reactive trades; I should base decisions on a clear plan rather than recent losses.","Buying equal amounts of five stocks at once used cash quickly, so I should consider diversification alongside keeping cash available for future opportunities.","My account's 2.5% rebound after a decline shows that monthly results can reverse; I should judge progress over a longer horizon and stay focused on my apartment goal."]}
